description: Collect live Bring a Trailer auctions, completed sold/reserve-not-met results, full vehicle specifications, seller details, photos, documents, and public bid history.

auctionStatus.description: For completed results: include every outcome, only sold auctions, or only reserve-not-met/withdrawn lots.
auctionStatus.title: Auction outcome

convertToCurrency.description: Add convertedPrice, convertedCurrency and fxRate using BaT's cookieless multicurrency endpoint. Original price fields are preserved. The endpoint converts at the current rate, not the historical auction-date rate.
convertToCurrency.title: Convert prices to

includeBidHistory.description: When details are opened, include every public bid with its amount, time, and bidder username.
includeBidHistory.title: Include bid history

includeComments.description: When details are opened, include the public comment thread with author, text, time, and likes. Bid history is controlled separately.
includeComments.title: Include comments

includeDetails.description: Adds full specifications, VIN, mileage, seller type, every photo, documents, engagement counters, and bid history. It costs one extra request per listing, so leave it off for large runs.
includeDetails.title: Open each listing page

includeTaxonomy.description: Adds category, origin and era to list-only records by querying BaT's facet filters. Up to 54 extra list requests; leave off for the cheapest runs.
includeTaxonomy.title: Fill category, origin and era on list records

listingType.description: Limit to no-reserve auctions, premium placements, or repeat BaT Alumni listings.
listingType.title: Listing type

location.description: Limit to one country where the vehicle is located.
location.title: Seller country

make.description: Manufacturer to browse, e.g. 'Porsche', 'Mercedes-Benz', 'Land Rover'. Used in mode=byMake and optionally in mode=search.
make.title: Make

maxImages.description: How many gallery photo URLs to include when details are opened. The total available count is always reported in imageCount.
maxImages.title: Max photos per listing

maxItems.description: Stop after this many listings. BaT returns at most 10,000 completed results per query, so larger runs are split by model year and category automatically.
maxItems.title: Max listings

mode.description: Choose live auctions, completed results, a keyword search, a make/model browse, or full details for specific listing URLs.
enumTitles: Search live + completed auctions by keyword
Full details for specific listing URLs
mode.title: What to collect

model.description: Model to narrow a make browse, e.g. '911', 'E30 M3', 'Defender'. Used in mode=byMake and optionally in mode=search.
model.title: Model (optional)

origin.description: Limit to one manufacturing origin, such as German, Italian, or Japanese.
origin.title: Vehicle origin

priceFrom.description: Keep listings whose current bid or sold price is at least this amount, in each listing's own currency.
priceFrom.title: Price from

priceTo.description: Keep listings whose current bid or sold price is at most this amount, in each listing's own currency.
priceTo.title: Price to

searchQuery.description: Make, model, or phrase to search, e.g. 'Porsche 911', 'BMW E30 M3', 'Land Cruiser FJ40'. Used in mode=search. Live auctions are matched on their title and BaT keywords; completed auctions use BaT's own results search.
searchQuery.title: Search keyword

soldWithin.description: For completed results: limit to auctions that closed in this recent window.
soldWithin.title: Closed within

sort.description: How to order the collected listings. Defaults to Ending soonest for live/featured runs and Recently closed for completed results.
sort.title: Sort order

startUrls.description: BaT listing page URLs for mode=getListing, e.g. https://bringatrailer.com/listing/1993-porsche-911-carrera-2-coupe-26/.
startUrls.title: Listing URLs

yearFrom.description: Keep listings whose model year is this year or newer.
yearFrom.title: Model year from

yearTo.description: Keep listings whose model year is this year or older.
yearTo.title: Model year to

title: Bring a Trailer Auction & Sold Price Tracker Input
